en: \[Code Review] Added `@claude review stop` (also `off` and `pause`) to Code Review, ending an `@claude review always` subscription on a pull request without starting a new review
zh: \[Code Review] Code Review 新增 `@claude review stop`（也支持 `off` 和 `pause`），用于在拉取请求上结束 `@claude review always` 订阅，且不启动新的审查
